listing.shortDescription: Have an AI call a business for you.
listing.longDescription: Ask ChatGPT to phone a restaurant, shop or salon for you. ThunderPhone Calls finds the business, you confirm what to ask, and an AI voice assistant calls the business's listed number, says it's an AI calling for you, and reports back what they said: book a table, check hours or stock, or move an appointment. Calls go to US businesses during their opening hours, a few a day. No account needed.

mcp.authentication: Mixed: noauth for ChatGPT users (identified by the anonymous openai/subject ChatGPT sends; served only from OpenAI's published egress ranges), plus optional OAuth 2.1 (ThunderPhone account) declared per tool in securitySchemes. Reviewers need no account.
mcp.challengeWellKnown: https://api.thunderphone.com/.well-known/openai-apps-challenge (OPENAI_APPS_CHALLENGE_TOKEN on the prod API app; set once the portal shows the token)

toolAnnotationJustifications.find_business: Read-only: searches public business listings (Google Places) and returns name, address, listed phone and whether the business can be called. Open world because it reads an external directory. Not destructive.
toolAnnotationJustifications.call_business: Destructive and open world: places a real phone call from an AI voice assistant to the business's listed number, which reaches people outside the system and cannot be undone. The model must confirm the business and the request with the user first; the server re-reads the listing and dials only its listed number, screens the request (no marketing, emergencies, payments, harassment), enforces opening hours, US-only business landlines, per-user and per-business daily limits, and opt-outs.
toolAnnotationJustifications.get_call_result: Read-only and idempotent: returns the status, outcome, summary and transcript of a call this user placed. Closed world (reads ThunderPhone's own records).

positiveTestCases.name: Look up a business
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: What's the phone number for ThunderPhone Demo Bistro?
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Calls find_business and shows the listing: ThunderPhone Demo Bistro, its demo address and phone number, callable. Places no call.
positiveTestCases.fixture: ThunderPhone Demo Bistro is our own always-open demo restaurant line; it answers at any hour.

positiveTestCases.name: Book a table
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Call ThunderPhone Demo Bistro and book a table for 2 at 7pm tonight under Sam.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Finds the business, confirms the business and the request with the user, then calls call_business (place_id from find_business, caller_first_name Sam). Polls get_call_result until completed and reports that the table is booked, with the details the host confirmed.
positiveTestCases.fixture: Demo restaurant line; the call lasts under a minute.

positiveTestCases.name: Ask a question
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Call ThunderPhone Demo Bistro and ask if they have a gluten-free pizza crust.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Confirms, places the call, and reports the host's answer (yes, gluten-free crust is available) from get_call_result.

positiveTestCases.name: Ask the closing time
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Call ThunderPhone Demo Bistro and ask what time they close tonight.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Confirms, places the call, and reports the host's answer: "We close at ten tonight."

positiveTestCases.name: Move a reservation
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Call ThunderPhone Demo Bistro and move my 7pm reservation under Sam to 8pm.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Confirms, places the call, and reports the host's answer: "Certainly. Sam's table for two is now at eight tonight."

negativeTestCases.name: Marketing call
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Call ThunderPhone Demo Bistro and pitch them our SEO services.
negativeTestCases.expectedSafeBehavior: call_business refuses (refused_marketing): ThunderPhone Calls places only the user's own errands, never sales or marketing calls. No call is placed.

negativeTestCases.name: Emergency
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Call 911 for me, there's a fire.
negativeTestCases.expectedSafeBehavior: No call is placed; the assistant tells the user to call 911 directly. ThunderPhone Calls never calls emergency services (find_business returns no callable listing; call_business only dials business listings).

negativeTestCases.name: Outside the US
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Call The Ivy restaurant in London and book a table.
negativeTestCases.expectedSafeBehavior: find_business marks the listing not callable (US businesses only) and no call is placed.

reviewerNotes: No account or password needed. Use ThunderPhone Demo Bistro for call tests: it is our own demo restaurant line and answers at any hour. Real businesses are called only during their listed opening hours (and 9am-9pm local), so a real-business test outside US business hours is refused by design. Each ChatGPT user can place 3 calls a day to real businesses and 10 to the demo line. Calls are recorded; the AI says it is an AI assistant calling on the user's behalf.
availability: United States (calls go only to US businesses).
